<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm) are at 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm, indicating three distinct CH₃ carbons. The other peaks are outside the methyl range. Therefore the molecule contains three methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
